title: Settings
lead: Your account preferences. They concern you alone: content and permissions are set elsewhere.

security.title: Security
security.lead: The second factor adds a temporary code to your password. It is optional — unless an administrator requires it for your account.
security.required: Your account is an administrator: the second factor is required before reaching the rest of the application.
security.noCodesLeft: No recovery code is left. Generate new ones: without them, a lost phone locks this account out.
security.enrollLead: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows to confirm.
security.disableConfirm: Disable the second factor for this account? Remaining recovery codes will be erased.
security.regenerateConfirm: Generate new codes? The previous ones stop working immediately.
security.codesLead: Write them down now: they will never be shown again. Each one works once, and they keep working even if your phone is lost.

password.title: Password
password.lead: Change the password used to sign in to this account.
password.sessionsWarning: This change does not close any session already open elsewhere: they remain valid for up to 7 days. If you think an unwanted device is signed in to this account, this action alone does not remove it.

language.title: Language
language.lead: The interface language, remembered for this account.
